description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.

                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Internship" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Internship">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_You" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Internship</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AcceptOrDeny</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AcceptOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DenyOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InvalidateOtherOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternshipUpdatesSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_YourStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternshipUpdatesJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RecommendSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RecommendMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Company" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompanyStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Internship" name="Internship search begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicMoney" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount of money"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetailsSplit" name="Enter experience and hobbies?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" name="Continue"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive an offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewOffer" name="Review offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptOrDeny" name="Accept or deny offer?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipUpdatesSplit" name="Write status updates in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_YourStatusUpdates" name="Write at least 3 weekly status updates about your internship"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates" name="Write 3 weekly status updates about you"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipUpdatesJoin" name="Status updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecommendSplit" name="After the internship, recommend the company?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendTweets" name="Send a separate tweet recommending the company to a friend">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfFriends</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecommendMerge" name="Continue"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessComplete" name="Process complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_EnterTopicMoney" sourceRef="StartEvent_Internship" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterTopicMoney_OptionalSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicMoney" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalSplit_EnterDetails" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">enterExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalSplit_SkipDetails" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterDetails_OptionalMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalMerge_ReceiveOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveOffer_ReviewOffer" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Task_ReviewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewOffer_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReviewOffer" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptOrDeny"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Accept" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptOrDeny" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerAccepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Deny" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptOrDeny" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerDenied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept_Invalidate" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deny_ReceiveOffer" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invalidate_UpdatesSplit" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesSplit_YourUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_YourStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesSplit_CompanyUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YourUpdates_UpdatesJoin" sourceRef="Task_YourStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyUpdates_UpdatesJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesJoin_RecommendSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipUpdatesJoin" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecommendSplit_SendTweets" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendSplit" targetRef="Task_SendTweets">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">recommendCompany</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecommendSplit_Skip" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendSplit" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendTweets_RecommendMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="Gateway_RecommendMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecommendMerge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_RecommendMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
